{{Quote|The Jedi received knowledge of a world in the Gardaji Rift, within the Tingel Arm, far beyond the bounds of Republic rule. There had been intelligence from freelance traders about an outlying community that built exceptional starships, small personal craft, sleek and beautifully made, and rated easily at zero-point-four. The rumors were associated with a mysterious planet, called Sekot by some, Zonama Sekot by others.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="RP" />}}
The '''Gardaji Rift''' was a region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], within the [[Gardaji sector/Legends|Gardaji sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]]. It was surveyed and charted by several expeditions in approximately [[229 BBY/Legends|229 BBY]];<ref name="RP" /> sometime between then and [[89 BBY]], the living free-floating [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] arrived in the Rift and settled in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around a yellow dwarf [[Star/Legends|star]] in a "[[Unidentified trinary system (Gardaji Rift)|triple star system]]" of a hidden region at the far spinward and galactic north side of the Rift.

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vergere]] first discovered the living planet during her [[First Battle of Zonama Sekot|mission]] there.
